## YouTube and short-form video channel

`project` is a YouTube and short-form video channel workspace.
Start an episode or a short by copying `episodes/_template/`.

### Layout

- `brand/`: Logos, fonts, colours, intro, outro, lower thirds. Read-only.
- `templates/`: Thumbnail, title-card and edit-project templates.
- `library/`: Material reused across episodes: music, sfx, broll, overlays.
- `ideas/`: Backlog: one .md per idea not yet an episode.
- `episodes/`: One folder per episode (`YYYY-MM-DD_slug`), copied from `episodes/_template/`.
- `shorts/`: One folder per standalone short, copied from `episodes/_template/`.
- `analytics/`: Exported stats and notes on what performed.
- `cache/`: Proxies, render cache, transcripts. Ignored by Git and disposable.
- Anything that fits no folder above: ask where it goes; do not invent a new top-level folder.

### Rules

- Each folder's purpose is in `FOLDERS.md`; read it before adding a file.
- One episode = one folder copied from `episodes/_template/`; nothing for an episode lives outside it.
- `<episode>` is that episode's own folder under `episodes/` (or that short's own folder under `shorts/`).
- Never edit, trim or rename files in `<episode>/footage/`; work on copies or in the editor.
- Draft exports go to `<episode>/renders/`; only the approved master goes to `<episode>/final/`.
- Captions are generated from the final master, not from the script.
- Every music or stock file used must have a licence file in `library/` beside it.
- Update `<episode>/episode.yaml` status on every stage change: idea, script, vo, edit, final, published.
- Uploading, scheduling or publishing needs approval.
- After publishing, save the exact live title, description, tags and URL to `<episode>/published/`.
- Never modify `brand/`.
- Run `git lfs install` once before the first commit.
<!-- kit:video-channel end -->
